'''Vladimir Zakharov''' ({{langx|ru|Влади́мир Анато́льевич Заха́ров}}) (born 1960) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr.Sc.]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]].<ref>[http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/3939 Annals of the Moscow University]{{in lang|ru}}</ref><ref>[http://cs.msu.ru/persons/zakharov-v-a MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis «The problem of program equivalence: models, algorithms, complexity» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (2012).

Author of 2 books and more than 70 scientific articles.<ref>[https://istina.msu.ru/profile/Vladimir_Zakharov/ Scientific works of Vladimir Zakharov]</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=28065&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Vladimir Zakharov]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
